title: Flaky: VS Code extension E2E (browser-debugger) times out waiting for Blazor page/WASM debug session to become interactive
test_name: Aspire Blazor browser debugger E2E hits a managed breakpoint for standalone / hosted-global / hosted-per-page
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
error_pattern: Failed to apply E2E control revision <timestamp>: Error: Timed out after ~288-295s waiting for Blazor page/WASM root session to become interactive/attach. Last error: <none>. State: {"debugSessions":[{"id":"...","type":"monovsdbg_wasm","name":"Wasm Managed Debugger", ...}]}
analysis: The test times out (~295s) waiting for the pwa-msedge child debug session for the Blazor WASM root to attach. The PR only modifies Aspire.Cli StopCommand and Aspire.Hosting Dcp/volume cleanup code, entirely unrelated to the VS Code extension or Blazor debugging code, matching a previously identified recurring flaky pattern in the browser-debugger E2E shard.
